title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Method Schedule: Customer Type, Account Holder and Covered Agreements
content:
The Bluegate AutoPay Authorization is offered in six methods. Each method admits one kind of customer profile and one kind of account holder, and drafts only the agreement kinds listed for it.

## Schedule of enrollment terms

| Method | Customer profile type | Card or account must be in the name of | Card networks accepted | Prepaid or gift cards | HSA or FSA cards | Agreement kinds drafted | Agreements per authorization | New authorizations per agreement in any rolling 365 days |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | Individual | The tenant | Visa, Mastercard, Discover | No | No | storage unit and vehicle, RV and boat parking | 1 | 4 |
| Credit Card | Individual | The tenant | Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express | No | No | storage unit and vehicle, RV and boat parking | 1 | 4 |
| Personal Checking ACH | Individual | The tenant, or a joint holder with the tenant | None (bank account) | No | No | storage unit and vehicle, RV and boat parking | 1 | 4 |
| Personal Savings ACH | Individual | The tenant, or a joint holder with the tenant | None (bank account) | No | No | storage unit and vehicle, RV and boat parking | 1 | 4 |
| Business Checking ACH | Business | The business on the customer profile | None (bank account) | No | No | storage unit and vehicle, RV and boat parking | 1 | 6 |
| Business Card | Business | The business on the customer profile | Visa, Mastercard, American Express | No | No | storage unit and vehicle, RV and boat parking | 1 | 6 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Customer profile type** is the customer type on the tenant's profile that may use the method: the Debit Card, Credit Card, Personal Checking ACH and Personal Savings ACH methods are for individual profiles; Business Checking ACH and Business Card are for business profiles.
- **Name on the card or account.** The personal card methods require the card to be in the tenant's own name. The two personal bank methods accept an account in the tenant's name or held jointly with the tenant. The business methods require the card or account to be in the name of the business on the customer profile.
- **Card networks** apply to card methods only. American Express is accepted on the Credit Card and Business Card methods and not on the Debit Card method; Discover is accepted on the Debit Card and Credit Card methods and not on the Business Card method. Bank account methods list no network.
- **Prepaid, gift, HSA and FSA cards** are not accepted on any method.
- **Agreement kinds.** Every method drafts storage unit rental agreements and vehicle, RV and boat parking agreements, and one authorization covers one agreement.
- **New authorizations per agreement** is the ceiling on authorizations set up on one agreement in any rolling 365-day window: 4 on the personal methods and 6 on the business methods.

## Hypothetical illustration

A business-profile customer holding two parking agreements and wanting AutoPay from a Visa card in the business's name: the Business Card method fits the profile type, the name requirement and the network; each parking agreement needs its own authorization, because one authorization covers one agreement.
